generate.queueEmpty: Words you generate show up here.
generate.previewEmpty: Generate a word to see its card.
wizard.title: Set up ankinote
page.soon: This page arrives later in the 1.0 rewrite.
notfound: There's no page at this address. Go to Generate.
model.intro: ankinote uses Google Gemini to write the cards, draw the pictures and record the audio. One API key is all it needs.
model.keyOptional: API key (if the service needs one)
model.keySaved: Saved key {hint}. Leave empty to keep it.
model.advanced: Use another provider, or choose models
model.advancedIntro: Each kind of content can use another provider (with its own key) or another model, and pictures and audio can be turned off. If Google isn't reachable where you are, switch card text to DeepSeek here. Anything you leave alone moves to the recommended model in new releases.
model.loadingModels: Loading the models this key can use…
model.listedNote: Pictures and audio are checked against the provider's model list, so testing costs nothing.
model.changeLater: You can change models any time in Settings → Models.
model.textFailed: Card text has to work before you can continue.
model.err.auth: {name} didn't accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
model.err.model_not_found: {name} doesn't offer {model} to this key. Choose another model in the section below.
model.err.quota: {name} says this key is out of quota or sending too many requests. Check billing on the provider's site, then test again.
model.err.timeout: The model didn't respond within 30 seconds. Select Test again to try once more.
model.err.unreachable: Couldn't reach {name}. Check the address and your network, then test again.
model.err.cannot_list: This service doesn't list its models, so the model couldn't be checked. It's saved as entered.
model.err.invalid: Something in {route} isn't filled in. Check the model and address.
model.err.server: The ankinote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then try again.
model.err.load: Couldn't load the provider list from the ankinote server. Reload the page to try again.
model.howTo.key: Sign in to Google AI Studio and create an API key.
model.howTo.billing: For pictures, turn on billing for the key's project in AI Studio. Gemini's free tier doesn't draw images; card text and audio work without billing.
model.howTo.noApis: There are no other APIs or permissions to enable: the key works as created.
model.mainUnused: Nothing uses Google now, so no Gemini key is needed.
model.billingNote: Gemini draws pictures only with billing turned on. A free-tier key passes this check, but generating a picture will fail.
model.hint.google_tts: This is a Google Cloud API key, not the AI Studio one. Enable the Cloud Text-to-Speech API in its project first.
model.err.api_disabled: The project behind this {name} key hasn't enabled the API it needs. Enable it in the Google Cloud console, then test again.
model.err.billing: {name}'s free tier can't use {model}. Turn on billing for the key's project, then test again.
